item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02030","case1_error":"Uses unjustified group totals and adds an extra 64 cases, producing 112 instead of 40.","case2_error":"Subtracts interest from the principal installment before adding it back, incorrectly canceling the additional interest charge.","reason":"The first introduces unsupported quantities into the total; the second incorrectly treats additional interest as already included in the principal installment.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02031","case1_error":"Treats each two-dozen set as 12 cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written product 15 × 0.40 as 30 instead of 6.","reason":"The first sets up an incorrect quantity per set; the second numerically miscalculates a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02032","case1_error":"Evaluates the correct expression 3,000 × 8 / 6 as 2,000 instead of 4,000.","case2_error":"Calculates the inspector's fee from the contractor's hourly rate instead of the contractor's total charge.","reason":"The first is a numerical evaluation error; the second applies the percentage reduction to the wrong base quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02033","case1_error":"Reports 74 without supporting calculations; the arithmetic-mean interpretation gives 40.","case2_error":"Evaluates 8 + 6 + 12 + 24 as 40 instead of 50.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported final number without showing its calculation; the second explicitly miscalculates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02034","case1_error":"Labels 45 training days as 45 weeks, omitting division by five training days per week.","case2_error":"Counts three sets as the first two, then adds another 15 after already subtracting the five missed push-ups.","reason":"The first fails to convert days into weeks; the second double-counts a set when assembling the total.","judgment":"different"}]}
